Rules: Emperor Edition core rules; curated Effect/Ability IDs, never inferred from prose.

Cards.Name: A Warrior's Wisdom
Cards.Text: Battle: Give your target performing Monk a Force bonus equal to his Chi (until the turn ends). You may take an additional Battle action.

Cards.Name: Desperate Mediation
Cards.Text: Battle: In turn order, starting with you, each player targets and moves home one of his Personalities at the current battlefield. Then, gain Honor equal to the number of Personalities this moved.

Cards.Name: Game of Sincerity
Cards.Text: Battle: Dishonor your performing unbowed Personality and target a Personality: Dishonor him. His controller loses 2 Honor. Neither Personality contributes Force in this battle's resolution.

Cards.Name: Inexorable
Cards.Text: Reaction: After another player announces a Reaction during the Combat Segment: Its effects will not negate other effects.

Cards.Name: Inspirational Address
Cards.Text: Battle: Choose your performing Personality and target a Follower in your hand or discard pile: Attach it to him, paying 1 less Gold.

Cards.Name: Shameful Death
Cards.Text: Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Magistrate Personality and target an enemy dishonorable Personality: Reduce his Force to 0 (until the turn ends). Give your Magistrate a Force bonus equal to the amount of Force the Personality lost (until the turn ends).

Cards.Name: Shameful Rebuke
Cards.Text: Battle: In turn order, starting with you, each player targets and moves one of his Personalities at the current battlefield home. Then, choose a player who loses Honor equal to the number of Personalities this moved.

Cards.Name: Striking Through the Void
Cards.Text: Battle/Open: Choose your performing unbowed Monk and target one to three Personalities controlled by other players: Give one of them -1F (until the turn ends). Give a second different Personality you targeted -2F (until the turn ends). Give a third different Personality you targeted -3F (until the turn ends).

Cards.Name: The Lion's Charge
Cards.Text: Battle: Bow your performing Personality or Follower: Ranged 2 Attack, with +2 strength if your Personality or your Follower's Personality is a Paragon. Gain 1 Honor.

Cards.Name: Wanted for Questioning
Cards.Text: Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Magistrate and target an enemy Personality: Your Magistrate takes him into custody. If he is dishonorable, destroy his attachments. Move him home.
